items.title: Register the human-readable baseline protocol
items.context: Create docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-workflow-efficiency-baseline.md with purpose, source incident, six dimensions, non-goals, and acceptance criteria.
items.userSees: Future Lattice optimization tasks have a stable written protocol before any change is claimed as an improvement.
excludes: Do not implement any of the six workflow fixes in this item.

happy.desc: The document exists and names the experiments/baselines JSON path.

edge.desc: The document separates observed behavior from target behavior instead of mixing baseline and implementation.

adversarial.desc: The document explicitly blocks arbitrary optimization and behavior weakening.

items.title: Register the machine-readable baseline JSON
items.context: Create experiments/baselines/lattice-workflow-efficiency-baseline-v1.json with observedBefore and targetAfter entries for all six dimensions.
items.userSees: Future optimization stories can compare against a stable JSON baseline instead of relying on memory.
excludes: Do not rewrite existing baseline files or story fixtures.

edge.desc: All six dimensions exist in both observedBefore and targetAfter.

adversarial.desc: The JSON keeps the original baseline immutable and requires separate result artifacts for future comparisons.

items.title: Verify baseline registration without optimization behavior changes
items.context: Run parse and invariant checks, then confirm the story made no source behavior changes for the six follow-up fixes.
items.userSees: The baseline is usable for future comparison while avoiding premature optimization.
excludes: Do not claim any of the six follow-up fixes are already implemented by this story.

happy.desc: jq and a six-dimension invariant check pass.

edge.desc: The git diff contains only the baseline doc, baseline JSON, and Lattice story metadata.

adversarial.desc: No Authority Server, provider authorization, delivery-check freshness, DONE summary, or validate timeout runtime code is changed.
